info.title: Integrations
info.description: Unified OpenAPI specification for integrations domain

post.description:
## Overview
Import products into a business account Available for **Staff Tokens**.

uid.description: Unique identifier of the import job

provider_data.description: The data used by the provider to import the records

source_import_job_uid.description: The UID of the import job that was used for validation

job_type.description:
The type of job operation. 'validate' will go over the lines and return errors, use /v3/integrations/import_job_items to get detailed errors about each line.
'execute' will run the import job. use /v3/integrations/import_job to get the progress of the import task.

status.description: Current status of the import job

error_message.description: Error message if the job failed

total.description: Total number of records to be processed

error.description: Number of records that failed processing

data_row_index.description: Index of the data row being processed

locale.description: Locale setting for the import job

shared_entity_data.description: Shared entity data for the import job, this data is shared between all the import job items

metadata.description: Additional metadata for the import job

success.description: Indicates whether the API request was successful (true) or failed (false).

data.description: The response payload. Present on successful responses (success: true).

error.description: Error message for simple error responses. Used in some legacy endpoints.

errors.description: Array of error objects for detailed error responses. Present on error responses (success: false).

field.description: The field that caused the error (for validation errors).

allOf.description: Generic wrapper object for API responses. Success responses contain 'data', while error responses contain 'errors' array or 'error' string.

## Overview
List all IDP Actor Mappings in the directory scope.

success.description: Indicates whether the API request was successful (true) or failed (false).

data.description: The response payload. Present on successful responses (success: true).

error.description: Error message for simple error responses. Used in some legacy endpoints.

errors.description: Array of error objects for detailed error responses. Present on error responses (success: false).

field.description: The field that caused the error (for validation errors).

allOf.description: Generic wrapper object for API responses. Success responses contain 'data', while error responses contain 'errors' array or 'error' string.

uid.description: Unique identifier of the IDP actor (a user in an IDP integrated with SSO to the inTandem autheriation bridge)

idp_user_reference_id.description: External reference ID of the IDP user, used to link the IDP actor to an external system.

actor_type.description: Type of the actor in the inTandem platform. 'staff' refers to a staff member, while 'operator' refers to an operator in the Operators Portal.

actor_uid.description: Unique identifier of the actor in the inTandem platform. This is used to link the IDP actor to a specific staff member or operator.

data.description: Maps an external IDP user to an inTandem platform actor (staff or operator).

400.description: Bad Request - Invalid input data or missing required fields

401.description: Unauthorized - Invalid or missing authentication token

403.description: Forbidden - Insufficient permissions or not a Directory Token

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Business logic validation failed (e.g., invalid actor_uid or actor_type combination)
